Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Campus Wide Worship & Baptism NIGHT

FCA, InterVarsity, ALIVE, & Campus Ministries are hosting a Worship & Baptism Night on May 10 at 8:00 pm in the Chapel! Come for worship, student testimonies, & snacks to follow. If you would like to take this step in your faith & be baptized, reach out to Joe ( brummelj@central.edu ) or Hannah ( laflinh@central.edu ) in the Lower Chapel. We hope to see you there!

Bot Bash Robotics Competition Tonight!

Assemble your robot and compete for a chance to win a cool prize! Teams will be assigned at the event, materials are provided, and no experience necessary! 
Where: VSC 243 

When: May 4th 6-8pm 

Winning team gets gift cards to Sweet Henry’s! 

We hope to see you tonight! 

Contact geistkempers1@central.edu or jablonskig1@central.edu if you have any questions!

Trade Snow for Sun: Merida, Mexico (Jan 4 - 15, 2027)

Looking for an unforgettable way to spend Winter Break? Join our faculty-led trip to Merida, Mexico ( January 4 - 15, 2027 ), and immerse yourself in the language, culture, and everyday life of the Yucatan Peninsula. Program fee: $2,250 (includes housing, most meals, tours, transportation, and entrance fees) *Airfare not included. 
Enroll in SPAN 160/260/360/460 – Language & Culture in Yucatan (1 - 4 credits) during Fall 2026 , and travel with the class to Merida, Mexico over winter break in January 2027 for an immersive cultural and language experience. 

Interested? Contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga (reynagao@central.edu)

Tutoring and Writing Hub

The Tutoring and Writing Hub is open Sundays from 6-8 pm and Monday - Thursday from 2-4 pm and 6-10 pm. 
Sunday: English, Religion, Spanish, Writing 6-8 pm. 

Monday: Calc I & II 8-10 pm; Comm 2-4 pm; Diff EQ 8-10 pm; English 8-10 pm; Gen Chem 8-10 pm; History 8-10 pm; O Chem 8-10 pm; Physics 102 6-8 pm; Physics 112 7-9 pm; Sociology 8-10 pm; Writing 2-4 pm & 6-10 pm. 

Tuesday: Accounting 2-4 pm; Comm 6-8 pm; Computer Science 7-9 pm; Kinesiology 8-10 pm; Study Skills 8-10 pm; Writing 2-4 pm & 6-10 pm. 

Wednesday: Calc I & II 8-10 pm; Education 6-8 pm; Gen Chem 8-10 pm; Study Skills 8-10 pm; Theater 204 pm; Writing 2-4 pm & 6-10 pm 

Thursday: BIO 131 6-8 pm; English 2-4 pm; Gen Chem I 6-8 pm; Religion 2-4 pm; Study Skills 2-4 pm; STATS 7-9 pm; Writing 2-4 pm, 6-10 pm. 

If you need a tutor for a subject not listed above, please contact Denise Koolmees koolmeesd@central.edu or (641)628-5919

Meal plan change for Fall 2026

Now is a good time to review your meal plan for next fall. If you are wanting to make a change to your meal plan for next fall please call or email Renae, 641-628-5656 or toolr@central.edu.

Central Student Tradition – Breakfast of Champions SP26 – Monday, May 11, 9:30-10:30PM

The annual student tradition Breakfast of Champions is back Monday, May 11 from 9:30-10:30PM! Enjoy Breakfast favs–Fresh toppings bar–fresh local donuts–all beverage stations will be open! Celebrate the end of the semester with a late-night study break where staff and faculty serve up delicious food, encouragement, and fun!

HISTORY CLUB LAST DINNER MEETING TONIGHT

History Club meets TONIGHT for the last Monay night meeting of this semester. Get your dinner and join us for great conversation, a game, and yes, scotcheroos!! Starting at 5:00pm tonight. In the Market siderooom closest to the cashier! All are welcome!

SAVE THE DATE-Business (EAM) & STEM Internship Career Fair

Mark your calendar for Tuesday, September 8, 2026 | 11:00am-1:00pm | Graham Conference Center 
Do your prep this summer: 

Submit your resume for review to Handshake. Create or update your LinkedIn profile. 

Visit Career Readiness & Experiential Learning site on myCentral for more resources.

Summer Online Spanish 122 (Beginning Spanish II)

Want to keep building your Spanish skills this summer? Enroll in Spanish 122OL , an engaging online course offered during Central College’s 10-week Summer Session from June 1 through August 7, 2026 . Please contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga with any questions.

Central College Slow Pitch Club Meeting!

The Central College Slowpitch Club will be having its first ever introduction and first meeting on Tuesday May 5th in Van Emmerick (Maytag 2nd floor) from 11:30am-12:30pm! All students who are interested in joining are welcome! We will talk about our direction as a club as well as any opportunities that are possible. If you can't attend but are interested please email luchiv1@central.edu!
